B3-map.dc.html.title: B3 Map behind: map brought forward

E3-comm.dc.html.title: E3 Lantern: tell bubble and Comm window

tA.text: A · Drawer: Comm rises from the bottom

tB.text: B · Map behind: the map is the text's background

tC.text: C · Deck: game on top, a switchable deck below

tD.text: D · Pages: swipe sideways between full views

tE.text: E · Lantern: one floating control, nothing else

sA.text:
A · Drawer

The game fills the screen. Comm sits as a one-line ticker above the input and is pulled up as a sheet (half, then full). The input stays put and becomes the chat field.

Move: a see-through compass over the text, lit by the room's exits. Flee bottom left.
Menu: bottom sheet.

sB.text:
B · Map behind

The map is drawn dimmed behind the game text, centred on you. No map view to switch to; a tap on the map chip brings it forward.

Move: a thumb stick (flick N/S/E/W, two keys for up/down). Flee beside it.
Comm: a curtain pulled down from the top hood.
Menu: a full page in the start-page look.

sC.text:
C · Deck

The screen is two floors. Game text above; below a deck about as tall as a keyboard that switches between Pad, Comm, Status and More. The keyboard replaces the deck when you type, so the game text never changes size.

Move: a big D-pad in the Pad deck, with Flee and quick buttons.
Menu: the More deck, no popup.

sD.text:
D · Pages

Three full-screen pages side by side: Comm, Game, Status + map. Swipe sideways or tap the bottom rail. Closest to today, done properly.

Move: a key row above the input (N S E W U D, Flee), like the extra row of a terminal app.
Menu: a drawer from the right edge.

sE.text:
E · Lantern

Almost all text. One floating lantern button: hold and drag it to walk (a joystick), tap it for a ring with Comm, Map, Status, Flee and Menu.

Comm: tells arrive as a bubble over the game; a tap opens Comm as a floating Lykta window.
Menu: part of the ring.
